From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Security review kickoff & scope — next steps (Orion Finance)

Hi Priya & Tom,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today — good alignment on goals and timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the security review moving: 

Recap:
- Objective: complete security review and procurement checks to enable a Dedicated deployment for Orion Finance by end of year.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: SOC 2 evidence, network connectivity topology, data residency controls, and SLA for latency.

Action items / next steps:
1) Fill in the attached Redwood Security Questionnaire (PDF) — this helps us prioritize the items your team cares about.
2) Can you confirm stakeholders for procurement/legal/security/finance so we map owners? Specifically: economic buyer, procurement lead, legal reviewer, and the technical owner for the integration.
3) Please confirm systems in-scope (examples below). If anything is out of scope, note that in your reply.

Suggested systems in scope:
- Redwood-hosted inference API (production)
- Customer data storage (S3 buckets consulted by Redwood)
- Integration for logs/metrics (CloudWatch/Datadog)
- Admin console access (RBAC)

We typically run a 2-week intake + technical deep-dive: questionnaire -> network diagram -> 60–90m technical walkthrough -> evidence handoff (SOC 2 artifacts, configs). Is that timeline OK?

I've attached the questionnaire and a short intake template. I can also schedule the technical deep-dive next week if you share availability.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Priya. A couple clarifications and a suggested stakeholder map to keep things aligned: 

Suggested stakeholder map (for our tracking):
- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (CFO) — final approval for contracts and budget
- Procurement lead: Laura Mills — PO/contract coordination
- Legal reviewer: legalprocurement@orionfinance.com — redlines and privacy review
- Technical owner: Priya Shah — systems access, network diagrams, and technical Qs
- Security reviewer (Redwood): Marissa Cole — questionnaire intake and evidence coordination

Clarifying questions (short):
- Data residency: Do any of your production datasets need EU-only residency?
- Access model: Will there be any cross-account AWS access to Orion-managed accounts, or will access be via API keys from Redwood?
- Logging/evidence: Is there an internal drive link we should upload evidence to, or do you prefer us to send artifacts over a shared S3 bucket / secure transfer?

Next steps from Redwood:
- I attached a response template (Excel) that speeds up our intake — helps us map answers to evidence requests. If you can populate the questionnaire and drop a network diagram (PNG/PDF) into the reply, we can schedule the 60–90m technical walkthrough for Tue 11/24 10:30 PT.
